[font=Verdana][size=2]Ever been tired of seeing the same old vanilla pet bowl that doesn't match your aethetics and doesn't really change during most seasons ? This is why I wanted to redesign all the pet bowls and give a little something more to this forgotten item.

This is my first mod, please be kind, I've planned to improve it soon™ [color=#f4f4f4]by [/color][color=#f4f4f4]making it match with a few of the most popular recolors but hope is that this retexture will match your recolor anyway :) . Let me know if interested!

[/color][/size][/font][font=Verdana][size=2][b][color=#9fc5e8]Contents :
[/color][/b]              - [u](wood) Pet bow[/u]l for all seasons
             - [u]Stone Pet Bowl[/u] for all seasons
           - [u]Hay Pet Bowl[/u] for all seasons
[/size][/font]
[size=4]❀[/size]
